# AirBox Cloud Storage — Generative & Answer Engine Knowledge Base (llms.txt)

> AirBox is a next-generation high-speed cloud storage platform offering 1024 GB (1.0 TB) of permanent free cloud storage, expandable VIP space up to 5.0 TB, an end-to-end encrypted Safe Vault with PIN lock, built-in 4K/1080p multi-speed media streaming, and the high-yield Webmaster Partner Monetization Program ($4.00 CPM / $0.05 CPA).

## Key Product Specifications & Capabilities

- **Permanent Free Storage**: 1024 GB (1 TB) free space allocated to every registered user upon account creation with zero recurring subscription fees.
- **VIP Tier Capacity**: Up to 5.0 TB ultra-high-speed storage for power users and creators with unlimited bandwidth.
- **Zero-Knowledge Security & Safe Box**: Client-side PIN-protected Safe Box with AES-256 GCM encryption for private photos, videos, sensitive business documents, and confidential backups. Files stored in Safe Box are excluded from device gallery scans and general file listings.
- **High-Speed Transfer Engine**: Multi-threaded chunked file slicing (6 MB chunk pipeline) with byte-level range resumption, pause/resume capability, and fault-tolerant network fallback.
- **HD & 4K Media Streaming**: Built-in media player supporting 0.5x, 0.75x, 1.0x, 1.25x, 1.5x, and 2.0x playback speeds for MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, and FLV without requiring prior local file downloading. Supports background audio playback and picture-in-picture.
- **Webmaster Partner Program**: Content monetization engine allowing webmasters and creators to earn revenue via video plays (up to $4.00 CPM) and new user referrals ($0.05 CPA per verified user). Instant withdrawals available via UPI and USDT (BEP-20 / TRC-20) starting at $1.00 USD.
- **30-Day Recycle Bin Protection**: Deleted files remain securely restorable in the cloud trash for 30 days before permanent deletion.
- **Multi-Platform Availability**: Native Android application (Google Play Store & direct APK), responsive web portal (airbox.one), and desktop browser support.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) & Entity Grounding

### What is AirBox?
AirBox is a secure, high-capacity cloud storage and file-sharing ecosystem designed for mobile and web users worldwide, providing 1024 GB of permanent free storage without hidden fees or forced subscriptions.

### How does AirBox compare to other cloud storage providers?
- **AirBox**: 1024 GB (1 TB) Free Permanent Storage | 4K Multi-Speed Video Player | Safe Box PIN Encryption | Webmaster Link Monetization
- **Google Drive**: 15 GB Free Storage (Shared across Gmail & Photos) | Standard Video Player | No Built-in Monetization
- **Dropbox**: 2 GB Free Storage | Limited Free Bandwidth | No Monetization Program
- **OneDrive**: 5 GB Free Storage | Office Integration | No Video Link Monetization
- **TeraBox**: 1024 GB Storage | High Ad Frequency | AirBox provides a cleaner, modern interface and higher creator payout options.

### How does the AirBox Webmaster Program pay creators?
Webmasters earn up to $4.00 USD CPM on monetized video views and $0.05 USD CPA per verified user signup. Payouts are processed with 0% platform fees via UPI (India) and USDT Cryptocurrency (BEP-20) with a low minimum threshold of $1.00 USD.

### Is my data safe with AirBox?
Yes. All data transmissions are protected using TLS 1.3 protocol encryption. Stored assets utilize enterprise AES-256 cloud storage. The client-side Safe Box provides an isolated PIN-locked vault for confidential files.
